title: Causality Is Key to Understand and Balance Multiple Goals in Trustworthy ML and Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical discussion of using causal graphs and structural causal models (SCMs) to disentangle true predictive factors from discriminatory confounders (e.g., adjusting for over-policing in the COMPAS recidivism dataset) and preserving minority representation in foundation models.

Theoretical application of counterfactual fairness for job recommendation systems, and the use of causal disentanglement and causal representation learning to isolate and reduce reliance on spurious gender-biased occupational associations.
